Sara da yayarta Tala suna zaune a ɗaki ɗaya: rabinsa na Tala ne, a tsare kuma tsaftatacce, rabinsa na Sara kuma kamar iska ta wuce ta cikinsa.

Tufafi a kan gado, littattafai a ƙarƙashinsa, alƙalamai kuma a ko'ina.
Tala takan ce: "Ki tsara kayanki, Sara." Sai Sara ta ce: "Na san wurin kowane abu, ba sai an tsara ba."

A safiyar ranar jarrabawa Sara ta tashi a makare, ta nemi littafin lissafi amma ba ta same shi ba.

Ta juya tufafi da littattafai, lokaci yana tafiya, bas kuma tana jira.

Sannan ta nemi takalmanta, ta sami ɗaya kawai, ta sami ɗayan a ƙarƙashin gado tare da safa da tsohon biskit.

Sai ta zauna a ƙasa tana kuka.

Sai Tala ta shigo, ta zauna a gefenta, ta miƙa hannunta zuwa shiryayyenta mai tsari, ta ba ta tsohon littafinta don ta yi bita a ciki.

Sannan ta sami littafin Sara a cikin minti ɗaya, tsakanin matashin kai da bango.

Da yamma Tala ta ce: "Kin sani, Sara? Manzon Allah ﷺ ya ce: Lallai Allah Kyakkyawa ne, Yana son kyau."

Sannan ta ce: "Ɗaki mai tsari kyakkyawa ne, kuma yana hutar da ke kafin ya hutar da wasu."

Sai Sara ta ce: "Amma tsarawa yana da tsawo, kuma ban san ta inda zan fara ba."

Sai Tala ta ce: "Mu fara da ƙaramin abu: kowane abu yana da wurinsa, idan kin ɗauke shi, ki mayar da shi wurinsa."

Sai suka tsara tare: tufafi a cikin kabad, littattafai a kan shiryayye, alƙalamai a cikin akwati, takalma a bakin ƙofa.

Sara tana dariya duk lokacin da ta sami wani abu da ya ɓace mata tun makonni.

Da suka gama, Sara ta kalli ɗakin, sai ga rabinta ya zama kamar rabin Tala, tsaftatacce kuma a tsare.

Sai ta ce: "Kamar sabon ɗaki ne!"

Washegari Sara ta sami littafinta da takalmanta nan take, ta kai bas kafin kowa.

Manzon Allah ﷺ ya ce: "Lallai Allah Kyakkyawa ne, Yana son kyau."

📖 Muslim ne ya ruwaito shi. Wannan labari ne na misali, bai faru da wani mutum na musamman ba.
